description.value: Café Gloucester is a Hong Kong-style Chinese café serving breakfast and all-day menus, with roots in Vancouver's Cambie Street and a newer Richmond location on Alexandra Road. The Richmond outpost offers dine-in alongside online delivery ordering, making it a convenient stop in the heart of Richmond's restaurant district.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands at 20m; rack at 48m; rack at 57m; rack at 85m; stands (7 spaces) at 91m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Richmond location at 110-8631 Alexandra Rd with phone 604 285 1631, matching OSM. The site lists online ordering and delivery services, confirming takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name uses 'Café' (accented) while website consistently uses 'Cafe' (unaccented) — minor stylistic discrepancy, OSM spelling retained per rules.
OSM opening_hours tag shows closing at 21:00, but website states 23:00 (Sun/Mon/Wed/Thu) and 00:00 (Fri/Sat) — OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by matching website content. Useful rest stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is a two-location chain; the OSM record and website content both clearly refer to the Richmond location at 110-8631 Alexandra Rd.

wow_evidence: roots in Vancouver's Cambie Street and a newer Richmond location on Alexandra Road; dine-in confirmed
